integrity: The infinite convergence argument is deductive from Bernshteyn's clopen approximation lemma and reciprocal formula. The accompanying computation checks only finite examples and is not used to certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result establishes right-c.e. approximation only; computability and left-c.e. status are not proved.
No efficient complexity bound is claimed for the finite cylinder maximization.
The effectiveness statement assumes a computable presentation with decidable group equality and a computable exhaustion.
title: Finite-cylinder approximation makes Bernoulli Schreier fractional chromatic numbers right-c.e.
